subject: music
title: Loud and Quiet
meta_desc: KS3 dynamics: pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff symbols.
final_note: Dynamics control the emotional volume of music.

concepts.def: How loud or quiet music is.

walkthroughs.body_html: Italian terms label dynamics. From quietest to loudest: pp (pianissimo), p (piano), mp, mf, f (forte), ff (fortissimo).
To get gradually louder, write crescendo (or a < hairpin). To get gradually quieter, write diminuendo (or > hairpin).
A piece all at the same volume becomes boring. Dramatic dynamics — a sudden ff after pp — make the listener jump. Music breathes through dynamics.
